notes.content: Two new languages have been added: English and Chinese. The AI has been enhanced, and the notes have been updated.

notes.title: map and mechanics update
notes.content: .The game has been optimized, the fog in level 2 has been removed, dysfunctional rooms have been locked to simplify the game, and the enemy character has been updated, and the level 1 map has been enriched.

notes.title: Map and narrative update
notes.content: "Level 1 has been updated with more details. Empty and plain areas have been enhanced with new visuals, and the map is now displayed larger. Images supporting the game’s story have been added, and you can now also see these visuals within the game."
